description: A large, sectional sofa with a chaise lounge. The sofa is upholstered in a light-colored fabric and features several throw pillows, including one with a deer head design and another with a geometric pattern. The sofa has a modern, minimalist design with clean lines and low-profile legs. It is positioned in front of a concrete wall with a shelf above it holding books and a framed picture. A wooden coffee table sits in front of the sofa, holding magazines, mugs, and a small vase with a plant.
